form.label: DOC - Create and Modify BSL Lookup
form.description: Complete guide for creating, modifying, and purging Splunk lookup tables

html.p: This dashboard provides comprehensive methods for managing Splunk lookup tables - creation, modification, and purging operations.
Lookup tables are essential for enriching data and establishing baselines. This guide covers all aspects of lookup management from initial creation to maintenance and cleanup.

pre.code: index=your_index sourcetype=your_sourcetype | stats count by process_name, process_port | eval baselined="true" | outputlookup baseline_processes.csv

# Load existing lookup, add new entries, save back | inputlookup baseline_processes.csv | append [ | makeresults | eval process_name="notepad.exe", process_port="0", baselined="true" ] | outputlookup baseline_processes.csv
# Update specific entries based on conditions | inputlookup baseline_processes.csv | eval baselined=if(process_name="old_process.exe", "false", baselined) | outputlookup baseline_processes.csv

html.h3: Method 3: Bulk Updates from Search Results

pre.code: # Merge new data with existing lookup | inputlookup baseline_processes.csv | append [ search index=new_data sourcetype=processes | stats count by process_name, process_port | eval baselined="true" ] | stats first(baselined) as baselined by process_name, process_port | outputlookup baseline_processes.csv

# Update only if conditions are met | inputlookup baseline_processes.csv | eval last_updated=if(process_name="target_process", now(), last_updated) | eval baselined=if(process_name="target_process", "updated", baselined) | outputlookup baseline_processes.csv
# Remove entries matching criteria | inputlookup baseline_processes.csv | where NOT (process_name="unwanted_process.exe" AND process_port="80") | outputlookup baseline_processes.csv
# Remove entries older than 30 days | inputlookup baseline_processes.csv | where isnull(last_updated) OR last_updated > (now() - (30*24*60*60)) | outputlookup baseline_processes.csv
# Remove entries with null or invalid data | inputlookup baseline_processes.csv | where isnotnull(process_name) AND process_name!="" AND isnotnull(process_port) | outputlookup baseline_processes.csv

# Completely rebuild lookup from current data index=current_data sourcetype=processes earliest=-7d@d | stats count by process_name, process_port | where count > 10 | eval baselined="true", created_date=now() | outputlookup baseline_processes.csv
# Always backup before major changes | inputlookup baseline_processes.csv | eval backup_timestamp=now() | outputlookup baseline_processes_backup.csv

# Combine multiple lookup tables | inputlookup baseline_processes.csv | append [| inputlookup additional_processes.csv] | stats first(baselined) as baselined, first(created_date) as created_date by process_name, process_port | outputlookup merged_baseline.csv

ul.li: Keep lookup tables under 10MB when possible
Use KV store for large, frequently updated lookups
Test changes in a development environment first
Document lookup table purposes and maintenance schedules

pre.code: # Check if lookup is working | makeresults | eval process_name="test_process" | lookup baseline_processes.csv process_name OUTPUT baselined | table process_name, baselined
